facts.fact: The GED document management system is developed by ANINF, with World Bank and other partner support, per GabonReview.
ANINF is building a shared digital base for the 29 ministries to connect to progressively, starting with two pilot administrations.
The pilot phase of the ANINF-developed GED was officially launched on 16 September 2026 at the SGG and DGEC.
